rationale: Jamie's work on context management for LLM workflows intersects with John's expertise in cloud infrastructure and agentic AI — both are thinking deeply about how to scale AI systems effectively. John's background managing cloud operations and his conviction around agentic AI could offer practical infrastructure perspective on how Twigg AI's Git-like context model could integrate into production AI pipelines, while Jamie's work on LLM tooling fundamentals could inform how John thinks about the operational layer of autonomous AI systems.
intro_message: Jamie Borland, meet John Komarnicki — you're both working on critical pieces of the LLM/AI infrastructure puzzle from different angles (context management vs. cloud-native operations), and your perspectives on how AI systems scale could be mutually sharpening.
